title: Essais, self-édition, Volume II (Livre II ch. 7-35)
author: Michel de Montaigne
edition: Général Michaud's 'self-édition' (Firmin-Didot, Paris, 1907), based on 1595 posthumous Marie de Gournay edition. Preserves period orthography. Original text section only; Michaud's modern-French translation excluded.
notes: Livre II chapters 7-35 (original text). Vol III (#58801) continues with Livre II ch. 36+ and Livre III.
